caseName: Willis v. Prudential Insurance Company of America
caseNameFull: Lorenzo Willis, Etc. v. Prudential Insurance Company of America
attorneys: E. Freeman Leverett argued the cause and filed a brief for petitioner., A. Felton Jenkins, Jr., argued the cause for respondent. With him on the brief was Woodrow W. Lavender.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The judgment is affirmed by an equally divided Court.

Mr. Justice Powell took no part in the consideration or decision of this case.
